title: Request a dataset in the data warehouse
summary: Get a BigQuery dataset in the company data warehouse for reporting or analytics, classified, with access for your team and a privacy check when it holds personal data.

resources.title: Data classification guide
resources.description: Public, internal, confidential, personal: what each means, with examples.

prerequisites.title: A GCP project to run your queries from
prerequisites.description: Query costs are charged to this project.

prerequisites.title: List of the tables and their source
prerequisites.description: Which systems the data comes from and which columns you need.

actors.name: You
actors.description: The analyst or engineer who needs the dataset.

actors.name: Data protection officer
actors.description: Checks every use of personal data.

steps.title: Classify the data you will store
instructions: List every column you plan to load.
Give each column a class: public, internal, confidential or personal.
The dataset gets the highest class of its columns.

steps.title: Raise the 'New BigQuery dataset' request
instructions: Attach the filled-in dataset request template.
Enter the classification, the retention period and the access group.

steps.title: Check the purpose and the retention
steps.description: The officer checks that the purpose is allowed, that only the needed columns are loaded and that the retention period is set.

steps.title: Remove or mask personal columns
instructions: Read the officer's comment on the request.
Drop the columns you do not need, or replace them with a hashed id.
Update the template and reply on the request.

steps.title: Create the dataset with labels and access
steps.description: The dataset is created with its classification label, the retention period as table expiry, and read access for your group.

steps.title: Run a first query
instructions: Open BigQuery and select your project.
Find the dataset and check its label shows the right classification.
Run SELECT 1 against it to check your access.
